ehrenamtsmesse-bayreuth-2026.beschreibung:
After a long journey, our 1st chairwoman Tatjana Belmar and our 2nd chairwoman Franziska Künstler presented KE!N EINZELFALL e.V. at the volunteering fair in Bayreuth.

Our stand led to many appreciative conversations, new encounters and lovely contacts. We are very grateful to have been part of this special volunteering fair and to have had the chance to present our association there.

Thank you for the many open conversations and the great interest in our work.
foto_alt: Two women in white T-shirts with the association's logo stand behind the KE!N EINZELFALL e.V. stand. Flyers and sweets lie on the table; on the left is a banner listing the association's services, on the right a sign about the petition.
A woman in an association T-shirt sits at the stand, writing. In front of her are flyers, cards and sweets, behind her the association's banner.
Sign stand with the poster for the petition “Secure care first. Then change care benefits!” and a QR code for signing.

stern-fonds-sexueller-missbrauch-2025.titel: State cuts support for those affected by sexualised violence
stern-fonds-sexueller-missbrauch-2025.beschreibung:
The Fonds Sexueller Missbrauch (sexual abuse fund) helped many of those affected where other systems were too slow, too complicated or not sufficiently accessible. Now exactly this support is being phased out.

The article in stern shows what consequences this can have for those affected – and why the decision means far more than a budget cut. KE!N EINZELFALL also has its say and makes clear what the fund was actually able to achieve in everyday life.

Why its loss is so serious for many people and what gap it leaves behind, you can read in the full article.

besuch-bei-trude-kuh-2025.beschreibung:
We had the opportunity to present our association at Trude Kuh – and are very grateful for this special experience.

We were welcomed by an incredibly friendly and competent contact, a professional studio and an atmosphere in which we felt at home from the very beginning.
